about_the_game:
The beloved character 'Zundamon' is now available as the third DLC character for Desktop Mate, featuring a brand-new 3D model and 28 exclusive motions under the supervision of illustrator Sakamoto Ahiru. Known for their distinctive, youthful, and adorable art style, illustrator Sakamoto Ahiru has gained widespread popularity, with "Zundamon" being widely used on platforms such as YouTube and NicoNico Douga. Thanks to this collaboration, Zundamon has been faithfully recreated in 3D, allowing users to interact with them directly on their desktops..

With this third DLC, Desktop Mate now includes a voice feature! Zundamon will now deliver multiple voice patterns, perfectly synchronized with its desktop movements, bringing a whole new level of charm and interactivity.

  • This content must comply with the 'Zunzun PJ Character Usage Guidelines.'

  • According to these guidelines, this content may be used for video distribution on platforms such as YouTube, NicoNico Douga, and Twitch.

Contents included in this product

Zundamon
